title: report builder: the three pieces #36374 left out (+ 筛选 under the data source, show zero-count groups, compare with the previous period)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · the remainder of #36374 (epic #36255) after PR #36644, which builds the report builder page. The seat split these off at L1, and that PR's acceptance notes name them.

## What is left
Three of #36374's "要做的" lines are not in PR #36644:
1. **「＋ 筛选」 under the data source** (item 3). The builder picks a dataset but cannot add a report filter.
2. **「显示数量为 0 的分组」** (item 3, a chart switch). The report spec has no key for it today, so this is a spec widening: a new capability, a separate Feature that waits on the maintainer's pick list (scope-creep rule, 2026-11-18). Note: this item needs that decision before any build.
3. **「和上一期对比」** (item 6, the time switch). It waits on the engine defect #35395.

## Done when
- 1: the builder adds and removes report filters on the bound dataset, the preview redraws at once, and Save keeps them.
- 2: only after the maintainer picks it: a spec key, the renderer honours it, and the builder offers the switch.
- 3: after #35395: the time switch offers 「和上一期对比」, and the chart draws both periods.

reach: every admin building a report in the console.
Business reason: these are the last pieces of the builder the maintainer approved on board 49, figure 3.
Reader: `domain:ui` (plugin-report builder; spec for item 2).
Blocked-by: #35395 (item 3 only)
Dedupe: `report builder filter`, `show zero groups report`, `compare previous period report` → none open besides #35395.
Grade suggestion: p2. Triage decides; item 2 goes on the maintainer's pick list.
